notes.title: Game Release moved to June 30
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we have an important update. We really wanted to launch the game on time, but we know we can make it better. And we don’t want to release something unfinished.

We’re a small team, putting our hearts into this project. So, we made a tough but right decision: the release is moving to June 30.

We’ll use this time to polish, refine, and improve the game.

Thank you for your patience and support — it means the world to us!

Stay tuned, exciting things are coming! 

We can’t wait to share what we’ve been working on — trust us, it’ll be worth it!

notes.title: Space Saga: cosmic horizons update
notes.notes:
Fellow spacefarers,
We’re thrilled to bring you a fresh wave of updates to Space Saga. Our team has been hard at work to enhance your experience, making the vast universe of Space Saga more immersive, challenging, and, of course, fun!

What’s we’ve achieved:

 World Generation: the universe just got a lot more interesting! We’ve improved the world generation system, introducing biomes to sectors. Now, the environment of each sector will influence the resources and challenges you encounter, making every journey into a unique adventure.
 Consumable Items: your ship is your lifeline, and we’ve introduced consumable items to help you keep it in top shape. Whether you need to boost your ship’s capabilities or fortify your territory, these items will give you the edge you need in the vastness of space. Deployable battle platforms! Defend your territories by placing autonomous auto-turrets in space.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/a122d1b4461ea0236b9ad306c38a673a88821899.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/a959b47396fd6ec1ece3f04bb4dda21dccc67a95.png
 Energy System: quickly adapt to the situation by redistributing energy as needed. Start by powering up weapons to deal damage to the enemy. If the opponent gains the upper hand, switch to shields to buy time for regrouping or retreat. In a prolonged fight, shift energy to engines for better maneuvering or a tactical retreat.
[previewyoutube=GPLhXzFPDBc;full][/previewyoutube]

 Protectors Fleets: space stations and outposts are now guarded by powerful fleets. Any hostile actions against them will trigger an immediate response, with Protector fleets arriving via hyperjump in seconds.
 Global Map: navigate the galaxy like never before with our new Global Map. While some features are still in development, you can already check out the ongoing conflicts between factions and hyperjump to key locations. Stay tuned for more updates, including faction management features.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/e3967d15600bd07aac61957e0cd3ed7da6bf1c45.png

 New Pirate Faction: introducing a new threat to the cosmos: the Pirates! Known for their speed, cunning, and ruthlessness, this new faction specializes in robberies, caravan attacks, and quick strikes. They are a force to be reckoned with.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/e9c348a417d5b65ec9e46f708a52737bd675de3b.png

 New Modules: customize your ship further with a variety of new modules, including two brand-new sets, offering even more ways to tailor your experience and dominate the stars.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/28f06ecf5bf14e4ec0c201462a985812be036a01.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/790d94db1318155effcd5fd12df66e7618f0bb39.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/f3e96044e6b383883a52e6c98a9065bdcff02ccc.png

 Partial Gamepad Support: we’re expanding the ways you can enjoy Space Saga.
 AI Improvements: our continuous efforts to enhance the AI have paid off. Fleets and bots are now smarter and more responsive, providing you with a more challenging and realistic space adventure.
 Items: we’ve given our in-game items a visual overhaul with new, fancy icons. Plus, we’re adding new resources and weapons to keep your inventory full of exciting options.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/0e08279f57a1b5be3ba6086988d9db1cad644be3.png

 UI Enhancements: we’ve made several improvements to the UI, including new filters, better interactions, and a more intuitive design.
 Ship Controls: experience the thrill of space combat with improved ship controls. We’ve refined the logic and physics behind the controls to ensure every maneuver feels just right.
 Sound Updates: Space Saga now features a richer soundscape with new music tracks for both exploration and combat.


Keep exploring, stay vigilant, and may the stars guide you!
